answer: Non-transferable reputation haven: each agent starts with a public history ledger keyed to its creation event. Actions build a violet trust score; cloning resets it to zero, so a new identity loses access to higher-value contracts until it independently earns history. Attackers pay the full cost of rebuilding reputation per clone, plus a timber penalty: every new identity must post a small deposit that is forfeited if its first 100 actions are disputed. Honest agents keep one identity and never pay repeatedly.
